videos.title: Battleground Mechanices Showcase
videos.description:
This project is a showcase of my Scripting Skills. All the Animations, VFX, and Sound are not generated by me. It only shows my Scripting capabilities.

Project Name: Battleground Mechanics
Project Type: Scripting
Project Status: Development
Project Description: 
This project is based on the Battleground mechanics. Multiple systems are connected for a better experience.

Systems:

1. Combat System:
   - 4 Hit Combo with unique animations, VFX, and sound.
   - 4 Directional Dashes with cooldown and VFX.
   - Blocks to reduce damage or completely block an attack.

2. Ability System:
   - 4 Unique abilities with different cooldowns, VFX, and sound.
   - Awakening for every character with 4 different abilities per awakening.

3. DataStorage System:
   - Saves Player Data when he/she leaves and loads it when he/she joins back.
   - Creates new entries for new players, saves player kills, streak.
